# dacode-dm-csv-011

## Instruction
Calculate the total quantity sold and total sales revenue for each bike category from 2016 to 2018. Ensure that total sales revenue accounts for any discounts applied to each order.

## About Dataset
This is the sample database from sqlservertutorial.net. This is a great dataset for learning SQL and practicing querying relational databases. [Terms of Use](https://www.sqlservertutorial.net/terms-of-use/) The sample database is copyrighted and cannot be used for commercial purposes.
